Hostel Database Design and Data Model, by Workflow
For each of the fourteen workflows: tasks, roles and responsibilities; how the tables correlate; and every item each table needs
Companion to: Integrated Hostel Workflow and Policy Blueprint, Version 2. The workflow letters A to N are the same in both documents.
Aligned with: the Infrastructure and Maintenance data model, the Inventory, Procurement and Accounts data model, and the Stock and Purchase Portal database.
Status: design draft for review by the hostel administration and the development team.

Each workflow section has five parts: tasks, roles and responsibilities; a diagram and table of how the tables correlate; the tables; the items each table needs; and the rules the database must enforce.

The design defines 84 new tables, adds items to 8 existing tables, and lists 21 existing tables in full because the flow depends on them. The rest of the two data models and the Stock and Purchase Portal is reused without change.
